relations.myth: Varro’s joint invocation of agricultural divinities
relations.note: Varro pairs Robigus preventing rust with Flora ensuring timely flowering.
The flamen asks Robigo to leave Ceres’ tender grain unharmed.
The flamen Quirinalis officiates at Robigo’s grove and sacrifice.
Gellius lists Auruncus alongside Robigus as powers placated to avert harm.

relations.myth: Celestial Dog explains the canine sacrifice
relations.note: Ovid connects Robigo’s canine victim with the grain-threatening celestial Dog.
